note: Yearly maximum heat stress per 4 degree cell, 36S to 36N. Levels: 0 = under 1 DHW, 1 = 1 to 4 (watch), 2 = 4 to 8 (bleaching likely), 3 = 8 to 12 (severe), 4 = 12 or more. Built from NOAA Coral Reef Watch v3.1 daily 5km DHW, sampled weekly at 2 degree points. Sources: NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP noaacrwdhwDaily and PacIOOS ERDDAP dhw_5km.
